zh: 每个新密码字符的选择互不影响：它要么保持原样，要么变成循环后继，所以一个字符能匹配目标字符 c，当且仅当它等于 c 或它的后继等于 c。
判断子序列用贪心：从左到右扫描新密码，只要当前字符能匹配旧密码中下一个待匹配的字符，就立刻匹配；尽早匹配不会让后面可用的字符变少。
指针 j 指向旧密码下一个字符；遍历新密码每个字符 c，计算后继（z 的后继是 a），若 c 或后继等于旧密码第 j 个字符就让 j 加一；j 到达旧密码长度时输出 YES，扫描结束仍未到达输出 NO。
en: The choice for each character of the new password is independent: it either stays or becomes its cyclic successor, so it can match a target character c exactly when it equals c or its successor equals c.

Check the subsequence greedily: scan the new password from left to right and match immediately whenever the current character can match the next unmatched character of the old password; matching early never leaves fewer usable characters later.

Keep a pointer j into the old password; for each character c of the new password compute its successor (the successor of z is a), and if c or the successor equals old[j], increment j; print YES as soon as j reaches the old password's length, and NO if the scan ends first.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Scan the new password from left to right, and match immediately whenever the current character or its successor matches the current character of the old password.

## Correctness

The choices for different characters are independent. The first position of any feasible matching is never earlier than the position the greedy picks, and replacing it with an earlier position never reduces the characters left for the rest. Repeating this exchange yields the full greedy matching; if the greedy cannot match the whole old password, no feasible solution exists.

## Complexity

Time O(n+m), extra space O(1).
